name: EPIC 205965738
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 18.7 solar radii and 0.96 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,242 parsecs away, 19 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.96 solar masses and 18.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,274 K at its surface.
